vitaminD.title: Vitamin D is different
vitaminD.body: Food usually contributes little vitamin D. Sun exposure, lifestyle, and clinician-guided testing matter more than this food log.

tofu.name: Calcium-set tofu
tofu.serving: A palm-sized piece in soup, stir-fry, or braised dishes
tofu.rationale: Adds calcium with plant protein and fits common Vietnamese meals.

smallFishWithBones.name: Small fish eaten with bones
smallFishWithBones.serving: A small portion of canned sardines, cá cơm, or similar small fish
smallFishWithBones.rationale: Soft edible bones can add meaningful calcium.

yogurt.name: Plain yogurt
yogurt.serving: One small cup as a snack or breakfast side
yogurt.rationale: A convenient dairy option when milk is not common in the meal.

mustardGreens.name: Mustard greens
mustardGreens.serving: One bowl of cooked greens in soup or stir-fry
mustardGreens.rationale: Adds calcium along with fiber and vitamin C.

soyMilk.name: Fortified soy milk
soyMilk.serving: One glass with breakfast or as a snack
soyMilk.rationale: Fortified versions can support calcium intake without relying on dairy.

clams.name: Clams
clams.serving: A small bowl in soup, congee, or stir-fry
clams.rationale: Shellfish can be a dense source of iron.

leanBeef.name: Lean beef
leanBeef.serving: A palm-sized portion in pho, salad, or stir-fry
leanBeef.rationale: Adds heme iron, which is generally easier to absorb.

porkLiver.name: Pork liver
porkLiver.rationale: Very iron-dense, so a little can change the weekly pattern.
porkLiver.caution: Liver is very high in vitamin A. Rotate it rather than making it a daily staple.

waterSpinach.name: Water spinach
waterSpinach.serving: One bowl of rau muống in soup or stir-fry
waterSpinach.rationale: Adds plant iron and pairs well with vitamin C-rich foods.

mungBeans.name: Mung beans
mungBeans.serving: A small bowl in porridge, soup, or chè with modest sweetness
mungBeans.rationale: Adds plant iron, fiber, and a familiar legume option.

guava.name: Guava
guava.serving: Half to one guava as fruit
guava.rationale: A compact vitamin C source that also adds fiber.

pomelo.name: Pomelo
pomelo.serving: A few segments after a meal
pomelo.rationale: Adds vitamin C with a familiar Vietnamese fruit.
